body_lead: The Telangana State government has launched the AI Rising Grand Challenge to resolve the public sector issues. State chief minister A Revanth Reddy inaugurated the initiative for serving as a unified data exchange, bringing together high-quality datasets from various government departments and partner organizations. An official release stated that the platform will support the development, testing, and scaling of AI solutions in real-world scenarios by providing secure and structured access to these datasets, as well as multiple other functionalities.
